caption:
More than 9 million student loan borrowers are in default. 🎓

They owe about $234 billion combined.

Wage garnishment and tax refund seizure have been paused since January. Reports say collections are expected to come back next year, but the Education Department hasn't confirmed a timeline.

If you have federal loans, have you checked your status lately?
